poll.source_locator: Post (October 30, 2026): 'Paxton at 48.7 percent and James Talarico at 47.6. Ted Brown, the Libertarian, takes 1.4 and 2.2 percent are undecided.'
poll.notes: With undecided leaners pushed: Paxton 49.4, Talarico 48.4. Post text read in a browser (JS-rendered) before the coordinator's no-browser instruction; full report PDF fetched by curl from the Google Drive link on the post. Sponsor/alignment follow existing Quantus rows. Class set 2026-11-01 to this pollster's majority precedent in polls.csv (self, PARTISAN_PUBLIC, R) per the refresh audit.

pollster.weighting_quote: Iterative proportional fitting, or raking, to benchmarks for the Texas likely general-election electorate on six dimensions: sex, age range, race and ethnicity (modeled), education (modeled), metro type and congressional district. Weights were trimmed to limit the influence of individual respondents and renormalized each iteration.
